Stack.label: A modern stack, proven in production

Projects.title: What we've <hl>built</hl>
Projects.sub: Apps live on the stores, platforms in production, client websites and products in progress — all designed, coded and maintained by the studio.

items.name: Powr
items.description: A strength-training log: custom programs, every set recorded, progression suggestions and a per-muscle volume map. Powr Plus subscription built in.

items.name: Rituel
items.description: A loyalty card for neighbourhood shops that lives in the customer's Wallet — no app to install. The shop stamps it from a simple web app.

items.name: Kepler Orbit
items.description: The studio's desktop launcher: game and modpack installs and updates, player accounts, news and themes driven from an admin panel.

items.name: Littoral Food
items.description: A full delivery platform — customer, restaurant and courier apps — with live order tracking right on the iPhone lock screen.

items.name: Kepler Business
items.description: The studio's client portal: quotes signed online, invoices, contracts, subscriptions and website monitoring. Operable by AI through its MCP server.

items.name: Saun'Activ Océan
items.description: The website of a seaside aquagym, sea-walking and sauna business in Brittany: sessions, beaches, sauna rental and custom events.

more.name: Que les Potes
more.description: An iOS app to quit doomscrolling: keep your friends' stories and messages, lose the Reels, Shorts and infinite feeds.

more.name: Star Academy Rebirth
more.description: A Cobblemon server and its custom mods: quests, a gym league, a casino and an animation studio, all wired to a dedicated API.

more.name: Empowered
more.description: An iOS powerlifting app — squat, bench, deadlift — that works out every load and connects to Claude.

more.name: Flux
more.description: A local-first expense tracker: virtual accounts, recurring expenses and category budgets, with no bank connection.

rituel.reward: 3 more visits for a free coffee

Services.title: What we <hl>do</hl>
Services.sub: Four crafts, one point of contact. We cover the whole product lifecycle — or just the part where you need us.

items.title: Mobile apps
items.body: iOS and Android, from mockup to store release. Subscriptions, notifications, Live Activities and Wallet passes.

items.title: Websites & web platforms
items.body: Fast, well-ranked marketing sites, SaaS platforms, client portals and custom back-offices.

items.title: Custom software
items.body: APIs, internal tools, automations and AI integrations. Desktop apps when the browser is not enough.

items.title: Hosting & care
items.body: Launch, monitoring, backups and ongoing improvements. Quotes, invoices and follow-up in your client portal.

Process.title: How we <hl>work</hl>
Process.sub: A simple, transparent framework that keeps you in control at every step.

steps.title: Scoping
steps.body: A first call to understand your needs, then clear specifications and a detailed quote you can sign online.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Mockups and an interactive prototype: you approve the flows and the interface before a single line of code.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Regular deliveries on a staging environment, so you can follow progress and react along the way.

steps.title: Launch & care
steps.body: Production release, store publishing, monitoring and long-term improvements.
